text: Russia has invaded. In the Kyiv metro, people made room on the benches so the children could lie down. Someone even brought pillows from home. We’re here in Kyiv and we’re keeping the lines open.
Bondarenko here. My people are at the shelter entrance, helping everyone down the stairs. Go ahead.
Let them stay. You’ve got a dragon waiting for you at the hangar in Pechersk. You’ll fly together and bring down enemy aircraft over the city. Stay airborne until the wave is over.
A dragon? All right. How do I get him to listen?
Steer with the left joystick and hold the button on the right to breathe fire. You can keep firing through a turn. Just give yourself time to get used to those wings.
His fire can bring down missiles too. In the campaign, you earn experience for every missile you intercept and every aircraft you bring down. Each time you level up, you get one crystal.
What do I do with a crystal? I can already picture him trying to bite into the first one.

Take it to Upgrade. Spend crystals there to give him more health, bigger or faster fireballs, or a shorter reload. After your first victory in Kharkiv, you’ll also get to choose Attack or Defense for the rest of the campaign.
Understood. I’ll go say hello. If you see smoke rolling out of the hangar, I’ve found him.
